title: The eleven
notes: The eleven. Coordinates for crew on the ground, and what the channel knows
about the ones who came up.

lines.text: INCOMING: U.S.S. ADIRONDACK
Shepard. I want to talk about my people. The eleven.
INCOMING: U.S.S. ADIRONDACK
Twice now. I'm going to keep calling about this one.
You've already brought some of them up. %2, last.
I read the quarantine log every morning.
Nobody has come up yet. That isn't a complaint.
Beacons come and go. The shuttle hears them first.
I don't know. Honestly.
Eleven went down. The beacons don't say who's calling.
I trained some of them. A couple I barely knew.
Some have stopped, and I don't know which of those
are dead and which just dropped the combadge.

options.text: What happens to them up there?
Why don't they walk to a clearing?

lines.text: Some can't walk. Some are in a basement with forty
of the dead on the stairs. They can't just walk out.

options.text: What happens to them up there?

lines.text: Nobody asked you to. Least of all me.
Bring me one and I'll be grateful.

options.text: What happens to them up there?

lines.text: Quarantine. Blood tests, mostly, and the Doctor.
Then a bunk, and a lot of staring at the viewport.
Nobody has turned. He doesn't know why yet.
Yet. You and he would get on.
Keep answering them. The ship pays you for each one.
I can only say thank you. Shepard out.
